policy: Upstream ref changes are reported, never enforced. A version change is not evidence that functionality fails, so it does not stop a release; releases are blocked by signals that do describe failure - a failing adapter contract, a failing upstream-schema assertion against the package's real shipped configuration, an invalid or ineligible qualification manifest, or an immutable tag collision. This file records what was actually qualified so that a human can see when requalification is due.

upstreams.name: OpenClash
upstreams.qualification: Full isolated provider transaction and rollback were qualified on v0.47.156; v0.48.002 has source-derived firewall evidence, not a full provider transaction qualification. CFI restarts this service and drives its provider controller, so a new upstream build is the first thing to re-check when a transaction starts failing.

upstreams.name: PassWall1
upstreams.qualification: CFI supports configuration persistence only; no running-service hot apply is claimed. Baseline advanced 2026-11-23 by release-owner decision from 26.11.11-1 to 26.11.23-1 without a new qualification run: the adapter writes configuration only and has no runtime dependency on the package version.

upstreams.name: PassWall2
upstreams.qualification: CFI PassWall2 adapter is unsupported; this canary tracks upstream drift and does not imply support. Baseline advanced 2026-11-23 from 26.11.11-1 to 26.11.23-1; no support claim is made for this upstream. The adapter is fail-closed on an exact package version.

upstreams.name: HomeProxy
upstreams.qualification: UCI persistence/transaction contract only; tested package 26.300.08316~d72e293 is not an apply-hot claim. homeproxy-transaction.sh never invokes init or reloads the proxy, post-apply probing is skipped for this mode, and CFIP_HOMEPROXY_SUPPORTED_VERSIONS is an exact package allowlist, so an unqualified build fails closed instead of silently misbehaving.

upstreams.name: Mihomo
upstreams.qualification: Live provider PUT was tested on the device's alpha-smart-g2e80ed7 core; the latest tagged core has not been separately qualified. CFI reaches this core through the OpenClash provider controller.

upstreams.name: sing-box
upstreams.qualification: HomeProxy runtime evidence used sing-box 1.12.25-r1; newer engine tags still require a fresh runtime check before any new engine support is claimed. CFI never drives this engine directly; its only consumer path (HomeProxy) is persistence-only and gated by an exact package allowlist.
